objects.title: 强形式相对 Morrison–Kawamata 有效可动锥原题
objects.model: Complex terminal Calabi-Yau fibre spaces in the exact original problem, relative dimension at most two, numerical pseudoautomorphism action image.
objects.statement: For every target fibration, the actual effective movable cone C_e has a strong rational polyhedral fundamental domain under Gamma, with no nondegeneracy or Q-factorial-base assumption.
objects.quantifiers: Every object in the fixed problem, including relative dimensions zero, one and two; arbitrary absolute dimension and all allowed boundaries.
assumptions: Exact Li-Zhao convention reconciliation must preserve the entire original scope.
objects.scope: Original problem, not a theorem proved by this intake.
objects.objections: G1-G8 remain unfulfilled. Weak Mov_+ results and abstract cone examples do not settle this statement.

objects.title: 有效可动锥、强基本域与两种线性部分
objects.model: Complex terminal Calabi-Yau fibre spaces in the exact original problem, relative dimension at most two, numerical pseudoautomorphism action image.
objects.statement: Distinguish M=closed Mov, C_e=M intersect Eff, M_+=Conv(M intersect rational classes), L_e=C_e intersect -C_e, and W=M intersect -M. Strong means exact weak separation plus trivial stabilizer in the numerical action image.
objects.quantifiers: Definitions for the fixed target and its associated real and rational divisor spaces.
objects.scope: Notation and convention ledger; source-dependent geometric conventions still require original-version comparison.
objects.objections: Do not assume C_e is closed, L_e=W, saturation under W, or equality C_e=M_+.

objects.title: 实际有效锥的有限稳定子弱域义务
objects.model: Complex terminal Calabi-Yau fibre spaces in the exact original problem, relative dimension at most two, numerical pseudoautomorphism action image.
objects.statement: Every fibration in RMKC-STRONG-REL2 has a full-dimensional weak rational polyhedral domain on its actual C_e with finite setwise stabilizer in Gamma.
objects.quantifiers: For every object in the unchanged target class.
objects.scope: Sufficient geometric premise for one route, currently wholly unpaid.
objects.objections: Not supplied by a weak domain on M_+; not assumed necessary for every possible proof.

objects.title: 有限稳定子弱基本域的有理多面体细分
objects.model: Finite-dimensional rational convex cone geometry; faithful linear action.
objects.statement: A full-dimensional rational polyhedral weak domain for a faithful rational linear action, with finite stabilizer, contains one strong rational polyhedral fundamental domain.
objects.quantifiers: Every finite-dimensional rational space, faithful rational linear group, invariant cone with nonempty interior, and weak domain satisfying the displayed hypotheses.
objects.scope: Complete abstract proof supplied; conservative candidate admission pending frozen publication, originality unassessed.
objects.objections: Application to all target fibrations is not proved. This candidate is not the geometric theorem.

objects.title: 相对锥猜想初始文献与版本缺口
objects.model: Complex terminal Calabi-Yau fibre spaces in the exact original problem, relative dimension at most two, numerical pseudoautomorphism action image.
objects.statement: Initial original-source audit separates strong from weak domains, geometric finiteness from polyhedral domains, and effective movable cone from rational hull; publisher-body comparisons remain incomplete.
objects.quantifiers: Only the original versions and passages actually identified in the source manifest, checked through 2026-11-22.
objects.scope: Preliminary reading dossier, not a complete prior-art certificate or a theorem claim.
objects.objections: G1 is not certified. Later and publisher versions require additional reading.
